sections.title: Twelve miles from Glasgow, with the train doing the hard work
sections.html:
Glasgow’s biggest venues are closer to Motherwell than many people expect. The OVO Hydro, Hampden Park and Celtic Park are all within about 15 miles of Bentley Hotel, and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk from our door. The fastest trains reach Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes, so you can leave the car in our free car park and let someone else do the driving.

Staying out here has its advantages: free parking rather than a hunt for a space, a bed in a Victorian house at the west end of town, and the restaurant and bar under the same roof if you want to eat before you go. In the morning there is a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order, if it is part of your rate, and no city traffic to get out of.

Two practical points. Check the time of the last train back to Motherwell before you go, or arrange a taxi for after the show. And if you expect to get back to the hotel late, tell us when you book or call us on the day, and we’ll make sure someone is expecting you and your key is ready.

Doubles suit couples, twins suit friends going to a gig together, and singles are a sensible choice if you are travelling alone.

sections.title: Why stay in Motherwell for a Glasgow show

items.title: Within about 15 miles of the big three
items.text: The OVO Hydro, Hampden Park and Celtic Park are all within about 15 miles.

items.title: Into Glasgow by train
items.text: Motherwell station is 5 minutes' walk, and direct trains to Glasgow Central take under 20 minutes at the fastest. From there the venues are a short onward journey.

items.title: Leave the car with us

items.title: Arriving back late
items.text: Tell us your likely arrival time when you book, or call on the day, and we will be ready however late the encore runs.

sections.title: Getting to the show and back

items.q: How do we get from the hotel to the OVO Hydro?
items.a: Take the train from Motherwell station, about 5 minutes’ walk from the hotel, to Glasgow Central, then continue to the venue by local train, bus or taxi.

items.q: Will we be able to get back to Motherwell after the show?
items.a: Check the time of the last train back to Motherwell before you set off, and if the show may finish after it, arrange a taxi. Tell us when you book if you expect to arrive back late and we’ll be ready for you.

items.q: Can we park at the hotel and leave the car while we are in Glasgow?
items.a: Yes. Parking is free for guests for the whole of your stay, from check-in until you head home.

items.q: Can we eat at the hotel before we go?
items.a: Our restaurant and bar are under the same roof. Opening times vary, so call us on 01698 265588 before you travel and we’ll have a table ready in good time for your train.

items.q: Is breakfast included the morning after?
items.a: It depends on your rate, and your confirmation shows whether breakfast is included. When it is, it’s a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order. Ask when you book if you’d like the breakfast times for your stay.
